newsitem.title: SPAIN: Repsol spends 60 bln ptas on chemical plant.
newsitem.headline: Repsol spends 60 bln ptas on chemical plant.

text.p: Spanish energy group Repsol said on Wednesday it would spend 60 billion pesetas of a 1.6 trillion peseta five year investment plan to build a styrene and propylene oxide plant in northern Spain.
In a statement, Repsol said the plant in Tarragona, Catalonia was expected to increase Repsol's propylene oxide capacity by 150,000 tonnes and its styrene capacity by 340,000 tonnes.
It should come on stream in the first half of 1999.
The plant will include an ethyl benzol unit, transformation units and a cogeneration plant.
The Tarragona plant will triple Repsol's volume of business in this area, and provides a more stable source of income as these products are among the least cyclical and high yielding of chemicals.
